Definition: a signal (literally or figuratively), as a flag, beacon, monument, omen, prodigy, evidence, etc.
BiblicalUsage: 1) sign, signal; 1a) a distinguishing mark; 1b) banner; 1c) remembrance; 1d) miraculous sign; 1e) omen; 1f) warning; 2) token, ensign, standard, miracle, proof
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
